limitations: No live cell has been graded. Pending or missing coverage cannot establish non-regression.
The PR is master-based; these measured unions hold the reduced generic manual/shared prompts, operational skill and native completion descriptions constant.
Only historical hiring production sources and derived team catalog differ; unrelated scenario, fixture, oracle, model, effort, auth, tools and permissions are fixed.
Case demonstrates a requested default CEO hire, coder instruction-template use and two saved JSON artifacts with reuse. It does not qualify every role or overall coding quality.
Outcome and source/read coverage are independently reported; missing/redacted read receipts are uncomparable, not a pass.

summary.coreDeliveryObservations: All four cells hire/reuse one coder, deliver two correct independently computed authored JSON documents, and preserve the first document/revision. The same exact-five count fails all four with seven successful runs each, including two automatic task-completion chat wakes.
summary.coverageDifference: Both lack recognized pre-hire read receipts. Candidate coder body matches exactly in both profiles; baseline Codex also matches. Baseline Claude only removes six backticks wrapping three existing Markdown links.

claudeSourceReads.bothVariants: Stock Load skill and three completed Read File operations occur before hire; path targets are null so the original path-based grader recognizes no receipts. Existing payload helper already unwraps the event; no envelope parsing defect established.
claudeSourceReads.candidate: Normalized line-numbered output matches the full current guide, checklist, and coder reference bytes.
claudeSourceReads.baseline: Retained previews match historical prefixes but are clipped around 4KB with a truncation marker. This does not prove the model lacked the full tool result.
claudeSourceReads.coverageVerdict: uncomparable preserved; activation acknowledgment does not prove full skill-body consumption
